# Talandon for Windows

Downloads of the Talandon desktop app: the Talandon accounting platform for Cypriot accounting firms in its own window.

<!-- downloads:start (written by the Desktop workflow of the Talandon source repository; do not edit by hand) -->
## Download Talandon 0.1.0 for Windows

- **[Talandon_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe](https://github.com/AndrewTtofi/talandon-desktop/raw/main/releases/v0.1.0/Talandon_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe)**: recommended. Installs for the current user, no administrator rights needed.
- [Talandon_0.1.0_x64_en-US.msi](https://github.com/AndrewTtofi/talandon-desktop/raw/main/releases/v0.1.0/Talandon_0.1.0_x64_en-US.msi): MSI package for IT deployment (installs per machine).

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The app updates itself when a new version is published here.
If Windows SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway** (the installer is not code-signed yet).

Released 2026-10-21.
<!-- downloads:end -->

- The app opens your firm's Talandon site in a desktop window; you sign in as usual. It holds no accounting data.
- It updates itself when a new version is released.
- Until the installer is code-signed, Windows may show "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run anyway**.

This repository contains only the installers and the update feed; the application's source code is private.
